description: Various insights about the game for displaying in the web app.

coach_advice.description: Lists of advice for each player.

anyOf.description: Advice based on rank of certain features in the distribution of games (how well the player performed in some areas relative to other games).

advice.description: A list of advice for the player to improve their game (ranked by relevance score, starting from the best).

ci.description: The confidence interval ([low, high]) of the value.

method.description: The method used to compute the CI for the statistic's rank.

relevance.description: Relevance score indicating how "interesting" this advice is (how much of a bad outlier is this particular stat). Higher is better. Calculated from the upper bound of CI, and then slightly weighted (with various weights for different stats) to make the typical advice more interesting.

value.description: The raw value of the statistic in question.

anyOf.title: Coach Advice

game_data.description: Contains data about the game overall.
game_data.title: Game Data

highlights.description: A list of the noteworthy exchanges within the game.

items.description: a section of the video that stands out
items.title: Highlight

player_data.description: Each player's data over the whole game for the web app.  If the player's location is unknown, the value for that player will be null.

anyOf.description: Contains player-specific data over the whole game for the web app.
anyOf.title: Player Data

rallies.description: An ordered list of the rallies within a singles or doubles game. This structure can also represent a distinct session or drill.

end_ms.description: The end time of the rally (milliseconds).
end_ms.title: Video Milliseconds

players.description: The positional information for players during a rally.  If the player's location is unknown, the value for that player will be null.

had_arrival_opportunity.description: `true` if this player had a fair opportunity to arrive at the kitchen in this rally

kitchen_arrivals.description: List of periods when the player was positioned at the kitchen line

items.description: A period within the rally when this player was positioned at the kitchen

ft_moved.description: Total denoised displacement movement vector in feet that this player moved during this kitchen line period, tracking x and y directions separately.
ft_moved.title: Vector

since_ms.description: Millisecond timestamp (from the beginning of the rally) when the player first arrived at the kitchen line

until_ms.description: Millisecond timestamp (from the beginning of the rally) when the player was pushed back from the kitchen line

items.title: Kitchen Line Period

started_on_left_side.description: `true` if this player started on the left side

players.title: Rally Player Positions

scoring_info.description: Scoring rally-specific information. Note that the running_score and the server_number reflect the score DURING this rally (so not taking into account this rally's outcome).

likely_bad.description: If true, this rally is likely bad and should be ignored while computing the ongoing score.

likely_correct_score.description: Our scoring algorithm has quite high confidence in the score of this rally. If you need an example of a rally with a specific winner, it's best to pick one of the rallies with `likely_correct_score` set to `true`.

running_score.description: The running score of the game during _this_ rally. The first element is the score of team 0, and the second element is the score of team 1.
running_score.title: Running Score

server_number.description: Server number for _this_ rally, is only there for the side-out scoring mode.

scoring_info.title: Scoring Info

shots.description: The sequence of shots during this rally.

start_ms.description: The start time of the rally (milliseconds).
start_ms.title: Video Milliseconds

team_stats.description: Team-level statistics for the rally (omitted for singles).

average_ft_between_players_along_x.description: Average distance in feet between team players during the rally.

side_switches_ms.description: Moments (ms in the video) where team switched their relative X position (left/right) for at least a second.

x_distance_optimality.description: 0-1 score of the consistency of the team's maintenance of the optimal x-direction distance between players (we consider 7-10 ft as optimal, and we give lower score for 5-7 or 10-12 ft. Everything below or above that is a 0).

winning_team.description: Which team won the rally (team 0 or 1)

session.description: Defines aspects of the session or game being played.
session.title: Session

version.description: a version string matching x.x.x where x represents one or more digits
version.title: Version

title: Insights
